ui.title: Chapter title
ui.selectedHint: Fill in the title, summary, goal and task sheet first; if the execution plan is missing when writing, the system completes it from here.
ui.emptyHint: Pick a chapter in the left list, then start detailing.
ui.failureDescription: Completed content is kept; unfinished parts continue from here.
ui.batchDescription: Detail continuously by count from the current chapter, or fill in all visible chapters or the whole volume.
ui.fromCurrent: Detail continuously from the current chapter
ui.batchHintLocked: Generate the current volume's rhythm board first, then detail a chapter or a batch.
ui.batchHintSingle: The current volume has only 1 chapter; detail the current one first.
ui.advancedHint: Conflict intensity, reveal level, word count, taboos and payoff links are in advanced settings so the initial form isn't too dense.
ui.selectChapter: Pick a chapter on the left, then start detailing.

batchHints.visible: Filters by the current rhythm and fills in the {{count}} visible chapters continuously.
batchHints.volume: Fills detail assets continuously for all {{count}} chapters of the volume, from chapter 1 to the last.
batchHints.count: Starts from chapter {{chapter}} and details the next {{count}} chapters continuously.
